# Grid Stroke Studio
> Gen Z-driven creative studio in Indore, India specializing in bold branding, high-conversion visual design, dynamic video reels, 3D CGI visuals, premium wedding invitations, and broadcast motion graphics.

## Studio Overview
- Name: Grid Stroke Studio
- Website: https://gridstroke.studio
- Email: gridstrokestudio@gmail.com
- Location: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
- Positioning: "We don't just design. We make brands look expensive."
- Experience: Founded by creators with over 2 years of individual industry experience.

## Core Services
1. Branding: Logos & brand identity systems that stand out. Comprehensive brand guidelines, packaging design, and tactile merchandise mockups (e.g. Meura apparel, Lotus Healthcare).
2. Social Media & Ad Creatives: High-conversion social media post sets, carousels, and paid performance ad creative tailored for D2C, education, retail, and healthcare brands.
3. Reels & Short-Form Video Editing: Hook-first short-form content for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok with rapid pacing, sound design, and kinetic typography.
4. 3D & CGI: Futuristic 3D product visualizations, procedural materials, and hard-surface renders created in Maya, Octane, and Blender.
5. Wedding & Luxury Invitations: Aesthetic digital invitations, multi-function ceremony suites (Sangeet, Haldi, Pheras, Reception), and bespoke typography.
6. Motion Graphics & Logo Animations: After Effects kinetic logo reveals, brand identity stings, UI motion, and broadcast title sequences.
